snippet.title: PSX Longplay [632] Final Fantasy Origins (Part 3 of 4)
snippet.description:
http://www.longplays.org

Played by: Valis77

Final Fantasy Origins is a compilation of Final Fantasy and Final Fantasy II for the PlayStation. It is the re-release of remastered versions (or enhanced remakes) of the Famicom/Nintendo Entertainment System classics Final Fantasy and Final Fantasy II. -
